job_proposal.compute: existing Free Edition serverless Jobs compute; no custom compute object, warehouse or cluster
job_proposal.run_as: Owner-approved protected principal only if verified supported in this Free Edition workspace; otherwise Owner-operated personal run-as behind the same root-controlled grant, one-shot ledger and independent verifier, never the Codex/DEV session
job_proposal.free_edition_compatibility_gate: Read-only workspace verification of Jobs Python wheel support, run-as identity, Unity Catalog privileges, wheel workspace path and independent readback is required before installation authorization
inputs: exact V3 request with later protected grant ID

install_and_submit_boundary: Owner authorization and protected extension are required; installer must rehash uploaded wheel and inputs, verify signed semantic record and operation-specific grant, disable serverless auto-optimization retries, reserve durable one-shot ledger, submit once, reconcile uncertain or quota-interrupted status and sign independent readback. A later quota continuation requires a new signed grant bound to verified remaining work. Existing V2 policy is not modified.
